name: Kyle Haustveit
summary: Kyle Haustveit, a petroleum engineer, was confirmed by the Senate on May 18, 2026, and sworn in as under secretary of energy on May 22, overseeing the department’s energy and infrastructure offices. He had run its fossil energy office (renamed Hydrocarbons and Geothermal Energy) as assistant secretary from September 2025.
